g.text: All 24 runs have a receipt whose bundle_md5 matches the run's provenance and the chunk manifest at the run's commit (0 disagreements); every manifest chunk has a receipt entry. The API arm holds the

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: whole bundle in context, so 'partially opened' is not an observable state here and the receipt is the run's own closed declaration per chunk; the receipt check verifies snippets against the bundle,

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #52514e
